title: Feature request: verbose & print mode together
body: I'm very excited about this tool. Thank you for releasing it. I'd love to run this in a github action every time I comment "/claude-fix" in a PR review. I have this working using --print mode, but I would like to use --verbose mode non-interactively. --print only outputs a very high level summary at the end. That means I can't see the process to get there, and that in turns means I can't effectively iterate on my prompts.
author: joesarre
